body:
# Limited Break
![Thumbnail?](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cb2aa17e8983e3309188eed71b80d9b87e6ce6fc.png)
Just a Simple Datapack For Fun to limit the amount of Blocks you may break before you Die in a Game where you Mine & Craft.

**To start**, Simply Run: ``/function limited:start`` And It Will Start Randomizing The Amount of Blocks you can break.

![Randomizer](https://www.image2url.com/r2/default/gifs/1783693089140-17faad82-4331-4622-9333-4e220c251bf2.gif)

By **DEFAULT**. It will Randomize from 10 to 100, But This can be **configured** by running these Commands:

``/scoreboard players set #min lim_cfg 20`` For the Min Random

``/scoreboard players set #max lim_cfg 200`` For the Max Random

**From that Example**, The Randomizer Will Be 20-200 Blocks

Andd thats about it, mostly just made this for fun and testing feel free to try it out :D
